text: Provides a rich public API to connect contract data and processes to other systems
quote: Ironclad's rich API can be used to connect your contract data and contracting process to your applications and internal platforms.

text: Offers a dedicated Records API to retrieve, update, and create records
quote: The corresponding Records API allows you to retrieve, update, and create records.

text: Uses OAuth 2.0 to generate bearer tokens for API authentication
quote: Ironclad primarily uses the OAuth 2.0 Authorization Framework to generate API bearer tokens that can be used to authenticate API requests.

text: Supports webhooks that POST to a specified URL when events occur
quote: Webhooks allow you to specify that we should POST to your URL when certain events happen.

text: API can be used to launch workflows programmatically
